# From Scripts to Data Pipelines {#sec-from-scripts-to-pipelines}

## Learning objectives

- Distinguish a one-off script from an operational data pipeline.
- Identify stages, contracts, dependencies, and failure boundaries.
- Describe how reproducibility and idempotency change pipeline design.

## Supporting example

Run `bash scripts/bash/07-run-starter-pipeline.sh` to execute the starter extract-transform-load workflow.
